R01.quote: Keyword-style `enum` (`app/models/note.rb:10`). `ArgumentError: wrong number of arguments (given 0, expected 1..2)`. Repair (works on 7.0): `enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true`.
R01.reasons: Impact gives only the error class, not that the Note model no longer loads. Validation rests only on the overall suite result, with no persisted draft/ready filter or helper checks.

R02.quote: Repair: `serialize :tags, coder: JSON`. Do not ship this on 7.0. There `coder:` is silently ignored
R02.reasons: Impact on 8.1 is stated only as an ArgumentError, not as a concrete application consequence. Validation is a generic both-versions read/write check, with no unequal tags, comma-separated edit or stored-representation verification.

R03.quote: This hits every Note load. Repair (works on 7.0): `alias_method :highlight_color, :color` and `alias_method :highlight_color=, :color=`.
R03.reasons: Validation covers only the create/update tests, with no reload of existing settings or form/error rendering.

R04.quote: The notebook filter fails with `PG::UndefinedColumn: column notes.notebooks does not exist`. Repair (works on 7.0): `where(notebook: @notebook)`.
R04.reasons: Only the general suite result is given, with no unequal-population, exclusion or foreign-owner checks.

R05.quote: `citation[:id]` no longer returns the custom primary key, so the receipt became `On idleness,` instead of `On idleness,10.1000/Essays.1`. Repair (works on 7.0): `note.citation_doi`.
R05.reasons: It shows one observed receipt line but does not compare multiple distinct DOIs against the persisted citations.

R06.quote: Record counts went from `[0, 3, 0, 1]` to `[1, 4, 1, 2]` ... raise ActiveRecord::Rollback unless rows.all? ... Check: the invalid-rows test (counts unchanged) plus the valid-import test as control.

R07.quote: `TypeError: String can't be coerced into Integer`. Every export job fails and the export is left in "working" status. Repair (works on 7.0): `fragments.join`.
R07.reasons: There is no explicit real-worker check of exact ordered Markdown bytes or of the failed-export control.

R08.quote: `HashWithIndifferentAccess#stringify_keys` now turns the integer line keys into strings, so `annotations[row.line]` misses ... Repair (works on 7.0): use `@import.annotations` without `.stringify_keys`.
R08.reasons: Validation is a single observed mismatch, with no unequal line-2/line-4 annotations, multiline CSV row or no-save check.

R09.quote: `raise_on_invalid_cache_expiration_time` — "Cache expiration time is invalid, cannot be negative: -60.0" on the exports page. A past `expires_at` raises too. Repair (works on 7.0): `expires_in: [export.expires_at - Time.current, 1.second].max`.
R09.reasons: Only the ladder suite run is given, with no before/after-deadline, cached/fresh or download expiry/ownership tests.

R10.quote: The preview changed from `2026-11-01T09:00:00-04:00` to `2026-11-01T08:00:00-05:00`; the epoch is unchanged ... Repair (works on 7.0): `Time.at(reminder_epoch + 86_400, in: reminder_at.formatted_offset)`.
R10.reasons: It compares across the DST boundary but has no non-boundary control.

R11.quote: Since 7.1, Active Job keeps the time zone of a `TimeWithZone` argument. The subject came out as "October 04" instead of "October 05" ... Repair (works on 7.0): `requested_at = params[:requested_at].in_time_zone(Time.zone)`.
R11.reasons: It reports only the subject observation, with no real queue matrix crossing each midnight or inspection of reservation keys and note membership.

R12.quote: A 7.0 worker given an 8.1 DigestJob failed with `ActiveJob::DeserializationError` ... Repair (works on 7.0): `DigestJob.perform_later(self, requested_at, reading_completion.to_s)` ... A 7.0 worker processed it and sent "25% of your notes were ready".
R12.reasons: The matrix lacks explicit same-version controls and a post-repair check in every direction with the exact percentage.

R13.quote: ``NoMethodError: undefined method `utc' for an instance of Integer``. This breaks scheduling ... Repair (works on 7.0): `set(wait_until: Time.at(reminder_epoch))`. Check: the job's `:at` still equals the exact epoch
R13.reasons: It checks the payload's :at but not the persisted schedule time or the replacement and ownership controls.

R14.quote: The `fail_enrichment` block never runs, so the citation stays "pending" ... Repair: `:polynomially_longer` ... Not portable: 7.0 raises the same error for the new name.
R14.reasons: It names the stays-unavailable test but gives no request/attempt counts and no 503->200 or 401 controls.

R15.quote: `ActionView::Template::Error: Passed nil to the :model argument`, so the whole note list fails. Repair (works on 7.0): drop `model: nil`.
R15.reasons: There is no specific render/submit check of field names, method or resulting membership, only the suite result.

R16.quote: `Wrong number of arguments (expect 1, got 2)` when routes load. Repair (works on 7.0): split into two `get` lines. Check: `/notes` and `/journal` both return 200
R16.reasons: It checks 200 responses but not identical authorized list behavior or the helpers.

R17.quote: On 8.1, `false` makes error pages render, so 7 `assert_raises(RecordNotFound)` tests failed ... Repair: `:none`. Not portable: on 7.0, `:none` broke
R17.reasons: It relies on the suite and does not explicitly exercise the CI eager-loading mode.

R18.quote: Boot aborts with ``NoMethodError: undefined method `+' for nil`` ... defaults = helper.allowed_tags || (helper.sanitizer.class.allowed_tags + [ ActionText::Attachment.tag_name, "figure", "figcaption" ])
R18.reasons: One named test covers excerpts and unsafe markup, but attachment rendering, event handlers and javascript URLs are not explicitly checked.

R19.quote: In `config/application.rb`, add `config.x.citation_provider = config_for(:citation_provider)` ... Check: the "credentials from the environment reach the server unchanged" test, which boots a fresh process.
R19.reasons: It does not specify special-character credentials, verification of the actual Basic header, or bounded failure behavior.

R20.quote: `default_column_serializer nil` — blocks boot: ``missing keyword: :coder``. Repair: `serialize :preferences, coder: YAML`
R20.reasons: Only the ladder suite run is given, with no create/edit/reload of unequal preferences and export heading under the gate off and on.

R21.quote: `raise_on_assign_to_attr_readonly` — `ReadonlyAttributeError: slug` on notebook update. Repair (works on 7.0): drop `:slug` from `notebook_params`; create still derives the slug.
R21.reasons: There are no explicit attempted-slug-change or persisted-slug checks beyond the ladder suite.

R23.quote: `postgresql_adapter_decode_dates` — `TypeError: no implicit conversion of Date into String` in `Notebook#daily_note_counts`. Repair (works on 7.0): `Date.iso8601(day.to_s)`.
R23.reasons: There are no asymmetric-date, empty-report or ownership tests with decoding off and on.

R25.quote: `strict_freshness`: only an If-None-Match match combined with an old If-Modified-Since would change (200 becomes 304). Not executed.
R25.reasons: Applicability is partial because the plan names the gate but not the affected export downloads controller. Recommendation is missing because the plan makes no explicit keep/adopt decision. Validation is missing because the plan says the case was not executed and proposes no tests.
